arguments.rule_content:
rule ShadowPad_APT41 {
    meta:
        description = "Detect ShadowPad variant associated with APT-41"
        author = "SOC"
        reference = "https://github.com/YARA-Rules/ShadowPad"
        tlp = "amber"
    strings:
        $s1 = { 48 65 6C 6C 6F 20 57 6F 72 6C 64 } // example pattern
        $s2 = "Global\\APT41_ShadowPad_2026"
        $s3 = { 4D 5A 90 00 03 00 00 00 04 00 00 00 FF FF 00 00 }
    condition:
        any of ($s*)
}

title: Detect Potential Mass Encryption Activity
id: d3c3f6a2-9c5b-4e0a-8f2b-1a2b3c4d5e6f
status: test
description: |
  Detects processes that perform mass encryption of files, but excludes known legitimate encryption tools.
author: SOC Team
logsource:
  product: windows
  service: sysmon
detection:
  selection:
    EventID: 11
    TargetFilename|endswith: ".enc"
  legit_process:
    Image|endswith: "\\VeraCrypt.exe"
    Hashes|contains|any: ["c7d8e9f0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8"]
  condition: selection and not legit_process
fields:
  - Image
  - CommandLine
  - TargetFilename
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate use of VeraCrypt or other approved encryption tools.
level: high

arguments.summary: A malicious executable taskeng_monitor.exe (SHA-256 e9f0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0) was executed from internal source IP 10.0.5.14 to destination 10.0.3.190. Sandbox analysis flagged the sample as suspicious with omitted events indicating credential dumping, SMB lateral movement, scheduled task persistence, WMI remote execution, and shadow copy deletion. The incident was classified as critical. Immediate containment via firewall blocks, binary quarantine, and automated Ansible remediation removed persistence, reset credentials, and rolled back configurations. No further propagation observed.

  service: security

  selection_lsass:

  selection_smb:
    EventID: 5140
    ShareName|contains: '\\IPC$'
    RelativeTargetName|contains: '10.0.'
  selection_task:
    EventID: 4698
  selection_wmi:
    EventID: 4688
    NewProcessName|contains: 'wmic.exe'
  selection_shadow:
    EventID: 4660
    ObjectName|contains: 'ShadowCopy'
  condition: 1 of selection_* 
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate administrative activity
level: high
